user_requirement: Exactly nine base instances in each of small, medium and large; shared demand and physical inputs across eight model configurations.
selection_rule: Within each declared customer-count stratum, retain the first listed number of family IDs in lexicographic order, profile 1 only, spread_medium only; do not inspect solver results. All core cases use Zhou coordinate units.
comparison_rules: Same absolute demand, locations, windows, releases, service/use times, network, fleet, cycle and applicable economic rates within a base instance.
B1 adapters may change batch bindings/calendar only; use the same final return cutoff as the reference multibatch calendar.
Do not fix optimized decisions to a model-specific best solution or alter physical inputs to force feasibility.
M6-M8 use the same exogenous K domain, minimum phase duration, nonempty delivery-and-return rule and explicitly checked time representation.
Current M1-M5 optimize distance; use common post-evaluation and a fixed-policy cost control to separate objective changes from expanded decisions.
Nine cases per size does not imply nine independent source instances; preserve source-block pairing in summaries.
Equal seeds and total-call budgets within a matched model/algorithm comparison; no solver execution is part of this design.
The underlying positive-integer K domain is common; model-specific exclusions require input-derived impossibility certificates and must preserve every feasible solution.

reviewed_reference_calendar.reason: Uniform feasibility repair after M03/M5 exact infeasibility and M03/L09 terminal-cleaning conflicts. Retain all 27 cases and physical demand; do not select by relative model performance.

review_protocol.experimental_unit: 27 matched base cases; 14 original source blocks; seeds are repeated runs
review_protocol.primary_cost_policy: User-defined basic coefficients confirmed 2026-10-16, shared across all 27 bases and eight projections
review_protocol.pool_charge_definition: One-time synthetic acquisition cost 5*N for the configured stock; reusing a box does not buy it again
review_protocol.cost_sensitivity: Freeze any coefficient variants explicitly in new studies; retain original attempts and inputs. Revision 3 is an explicit user-authorized primary-profile change.
metrics: comparable cost for reusable models only
review_protocol.objective_control: A common cost recalculation is not a fixed-policy cost optimization control. Do not attribute M5/M6 differences solely to additional decisions without that control.
review_protocol.reporting: Report each size separately, pair by base case, retain source_block for block-balanced summaries; never treat all runs as independent cases.
review_protocol.feasibility_denominator: All planned runs, including timeouts, heuristic no-solution and audit failures
review_protocol.witness_policy: 216 independently replayed schedules certify feasibility; they are not optimal and are not loaded automatically by benchmark solvers.
review_protocol.k_domain_policy: Start with the common positive-integer domain. Remove only input-proven impossible counts; each exclusion is recorded and recomputed.
scope_limits: One synthetic appointment and economic regime; not a representative empirical population
E1 capacity is deliberately loose; not an E1 scarcity benchmark
All orders released at cycle start; not a late-release stress benchmark
Most fixed assignments are already nearest-satellite assignments
A low-cost single-batch optimum is an admissible finding; do not tune prices to guarantee M8 wins

M5 fixes dispatch slots but does not require positive recovery in each slot; M6-M8 require productive delivery and recovery. Without harmonizing this rule, M5 is not automatically a strict subset control for M6.
review_protocol.formal_experiment_status: Revision-2 formal results are historical. Revision-3 costs require a new prepared study and fresh optimization.

separate_purchase_and_wear_accounting.pool_charge: 5*N one-time acquisition cost within the optimization
separate_purchase_and_wear_accounting.wear_in_objective: 0.01*Q explicit per-use wear; independent of purchase price, no lifetime depreciation
separate_purchase_and_wear_accounting.cleaning_and_tracking: One combined fee 0.01*Q, stored as cleaning; tracking coefficient is zero
separate_purchase_and_wear_accounting.initial_investment_reported_separately: 5*N informational purchase metric; same purchase charge, not added a second time
separate_purchase_and_wear_accounting.implication: For fixed demand and complete recovery, per-use fees sum to constant 0.02*Q; stock and weighted distances drive the decision.

demand_contract.goods_weight: Preserve the complete original customer goods weight.
demand_contract.assumption: Each customer demand fits one standard box; no bin-packing optimization.
